name: E-Mountainbike Sunset Tour
beschreibung:
This tour is a guided e-mountain bike experience in the Ötztal that combines the Tyrolean mountain world with a sunset over the peaks. Thanks to electric assistance, according to the description the route is suitable for every fitness level; it leads along picturesque alpine pasture paths and scenic trails to a viewpoint for the sunset. A duration of three to four hours and a price of 89 euros are specified.

The Ötztal is one of the most important bike regions in the Alps: the Ötztal cycle path runs for around 50 kilometres from Haiming to Sölden, and in the Längenfeld region numerous tours run from the valley floor along the Ötztaler Ache up to alpine pastures and huts. A specific provider of this sunset tour could not be clearly determined through official sources.
